import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

nodes = {
    "data_platform":    {"label": "Data Platform\n(Spark / Flink)",       "category": "data-layer",        "criticality": 9},
    "feature_store":    {"label": "Feature Store",                         "category": "data-layer",        "criticality": 8},
    "training_cluster": {"label": "Training Cluster\n(GPU)",               "category": "compute-layer",     "criticality": 10},
    "model_registry":   {"label": "Model Registry",                        "category": "compute-layer",     "criticality": 8},
    "inference_online":  {"label": "Inference Service\n(Online / RT)",     "category": "serving-layer",     "criticality": 9},
    "inference_offline": {"label": "Inference Service\n(Offline / Batch)", "category": "serving-layer",     "criticality": 7},
    "ab_experiment":    {"label": "A/B Experiment\nPlatform",              "category": "serving-layer",     "criticality": 8},
    "monitoring":       {"label": "Monitoring &\nAlerting",                "category": "observability-layer","criticality": 9},
    "version_control":  {"label": "Version Control\n& Data Lineage",      "category": "observability-layer","criticality": 7},
}

edges = [
    # primary
    ("data_platform",    "feature_store",    "primary",  12.5, "Raw → Features"),
    ("feature_store",    "training_cluster", "primary",   8.0, "Training Data"),
    ("training_cluster", "model_registry",   "primary",   2.5, "Trained Models"),
    ("model_registry",   "inference_online",  "primary",  1.8, "Model Deploy (Online)"),
    ("model_registry",   "inference_offline", "primary",  3.2, "Model Deploy (Batch)"),
    ("inference_online",  "ab_experiment",   "primary",   5.0, "Predictions (RT)"),
    ("inference_offline", "ab_experiment",   "primary",   4.0, "Predictions (Batch)"),
    ("ab_experiment",    "monitoring",       "primary",   2.0, "Metrics & Results"),
    ("feature_store",    "inference_online",  "primary",  6.0, "Online Features"),
    # feedback
    ("monitoring", "data_platform",    "feedback", 0.5, "Data Quality Alerts"),
    ("monitoring", "training_cluster", "feedback", 0.3, "Retrain Trigger"),
    # lineage
    ("data_platform",   "version_control",  "lineage", 0.2, "Data Lineage"),
    ("version_control", "feature_store",    "lineage", 0.1, "Feature Versioning"),
    ("version_control", "training_cluster", "lineage", 0.1, "Experiment Tracking"),
    ("version_control", "model_registry",   "lineage", 0.1, "Model Lineage"),
]

# ── Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

LAYER_COLOR = {
    "data-layer":        "#2979FF",   # blue
    "compute-layer":     "#00C853",   # green
    "serving-layer":     "#FF6D00",   # orange
    "observability-layer": "#F44336", # red
}

EDGE_COLOR = {
    "primary":  "#B0BEC5",  # soft silver
    "feedback": "#FF4081",  # pink/magenta
    "lineage":  "#CE93D8",  # purple
}

BG   = "#0D1117"
TEXT = "#E0E0E0"

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Custom positions for clear pipeline flow (left→right, top→bottom)
#
#  Col:   0        1           2             3              4
#  Row0:  Data     Feature     Training     Model          A/B
#  Row1:  Platform Store       Cluster      Registry       Experiment
#  Row2:           (Version)               (Inf Online)    Monitoring
#                                          (Inf Offline)
#
# We'll use a layered approach:
#  x=0  data_platform
#  x=1  feature_store
#  x=2  training_cluster
#  x=3  model_registry
#  x=4.5 inference_online  (top branch)
#  x=4.5 inference_offline (bottom branch)
#  x=6  ab_experiment
#  x=7  monitoring
#  x=1  version_control (below, cross-cutting)

pos = {
    "data_platform":    (0.0,  0.0),
    "feature_store":    (2.0,  0.0),
    "training_cluster": (4.0,  0.0),
    "model_registry":   (6.0,  0.0),
    "inference_online":  (8.0,  0.8),
    "inference_offline": (8.0, -0.8),
    "ab_experiment":    (10.0,  0.0),
    "monitoring":       (12.0,  0.0),
    "version_control":  (3.5, -2.8),
}

# ── Figure ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 11), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_facecolor(BG)
ax.set_xlim(-1.4, 13.5)
ax.set_ylim(-4.0, 2.5)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Draw edges ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def draw_arrow(ax, src, tgt, flow_type, throughput, label_text):
    x0, y0 = pos[src]
    x1, y1 = pos[tgt]

    color  = EDGE_COLOR[flow_type]
    lw     = 0.5 + (throughput / 12.5) * 5.5   # scale 0.5–6
    ls     = '--' if flow_type == 'lineage' else '-'
    alpha  = 0.55 if flow_type == 'lineage' else (0.65 if flow_type == 'feedback' else 0.85)

    # Slight curve for feedback edges to avoid overlap
    rad = 0.0
    if flow_type == 'feedback':
        rad = -0.35

    arr = FancyArrowPatch(
        (x0, y0), (x1, y1),
        arrowstyle='-|>',
        mutation_scale=14,
        linewidth=lw,
        linestyle=ls,
        color=color,
        alpha=alpha,
        connectionstyle=f"arc3,rad={rad}",
        zorder=1,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arr)

    # Edge label (only primary, non-feedback to avoid clutter)
    if flow_type == 'primary' and throughput >= 2.0:
        mx = (x0 + x1) / 2
        my = (y0 + y1) / 2 + 0.18
        ax.text(mx, my, f"{throughput:.1f} Gbps",
                ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5, color=color,
                alpha=0.85, zorder=5,
                path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=1.5, foreground=BG)])

for (src, tgt, ft, tp, lbl) in edges:
    draw_arrow(ax, src, tgt, ft, tp, lbl)

# ── Draw nodes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

NODE_W = 1.6
NODE_H_BASE = 0.55

for nid, ndata in nodes.items():
    x, y = pos[nid]
    cat  = ndata["category"]
    crit = ndata["criticality"]
    color = LAYER_COLOR[cat]

    # Node size by criticality
    w = NODE_W * (0.8 + crit / 10 * 0.4)
    h = NODE_H_BASE * (0.8 + crit / 10 * 0.4)

    # Glow border
    glow = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - w/2 - 0.06, y - h/2 - 0.06), w + 0.12, h + 0.12,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
        facecolor='none',
        edgecolor=color,
        linewidth=3.5,
        alpha=0.25,
        zorder=2,
    )
    ax.add_patch(glow)

    # Main box
    box = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch(
        (x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
        facecolor=color + "33",   # 20% fill
        edgecolor=color,
        linewidth=1.8,
        zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(box)

    # Label
    lines = ndata["label"].split('\n')
    main  = lines[0]
    sub   = lines[1] if len(lines) > 1 else ''
    ax.text(x, y + (0.06 if sub else 0), main,
            ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT,
            zorder=4)
    if sub:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.17, sub,
                ha='center', va='center',
                fontsize=7.0, color=color,
                zorder=4)

    # Criticality badge
    badge_x = x + w/2 + 0.02
    badge_y = y + h/2 + 0.02
    ax.annotate(f"  {crit}  ",
                xy=(badge_x, badge_y),
                fontsize=6.5, color='#0D1117', fontweight='bold',
                ha='center', va='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', fc=color, ec='none', alpha=0.9),
                zorder=5)

# ── Branch annotation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ax.annotate("", xy=(8.0, 0.25), xytext=(6.8, 0.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#FF6D00', lw=1.2, alpha=0.5))
ax.text(7.3, 0.38, "Online /\nOffline Split",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7, color='#FF6D00', alpha=0.75,
        style='italic')

# ── Feedback loop annotation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

ax.annotate("Closed-Loop MLOps",
            xy=(6.0, -1.6),
            ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=8, color='#FF4081', alpha=0.7,
            style='italic',
            path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground=BG)])

# ── Version control annotation ────────────────────────────────────────────────

ax.text(3.5, -3.55, "Cross-Cutting: Data Lineage & Version Control overlay",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.5, color='#CE93D8', alpha=0.75,
        style='italic')

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

legend_y  = 2.25
legend_x  = -1.2
spacing_x = 2.4

# Layer legend
layer_items = [
    ("data-layer",        "Data Layer"),
    ("compute-layer",     "Compute Layer"),
    ("serving-layer",     "Serving Layer"),
    ("observability-layer","Observability Layer"),
]
for i, (cat, lbl) in enumerate(layer_items):
    cx = legend_x + i * spacing_x
    patch = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((cx - 0.18, legend_y - 0.12), 0.36, 0.24,
                                    boxstyle="round,pad=0.03",
                                    facecolor=LAYER_COLOR[cat] + "44",
                                    edgecolor=LAYER_COLOR[cat], linewidth=1.4)
    ax.add_patch(patch)
    ax.text(cx + 0.28, legend_y, lbl,
            va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT)

# Edge type legend
eline_items = [
    ("primary",  "─── Primary Flow",  False),
    ("feedback", "─── Feedback Loop", False),
    ("lineage",  "- - Lineage Link",  True),
]
for i, (ft, lbl, dash) in enumerate(eline_items):
    ex = legend_x + i * spacing_x
    ey = legend_y - 0.55
    ls = '--' if dash else '-'
    ax.plot([ex - 0.22, ex + 0.22], [ey, ey],
            color=EDGE_COLOR[ft], lw=2.0, linestyle=ls, alpha=0.9)
    ax.text(ex + 0.32, ey, lbl,
            va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT)

# Criticality badge legend
ax.text(legend_x + 3 * spacing_x, legend_y - 0.55,
        "  Node size & badge = criticality (1–10)  ",
        va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='#1E1E2E', ec='#555', lw=0.8))

# Edge thickness legend
ax.text(legend_x + 3 * spacing_x, legend_y,
        "  Edge thickness = throughput (Gbps)  ",
        va='center', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', fc='#1E1E2E', ec='#555', lw=0.8))

# ── Title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ax.text(6.0, 2.38,
        "ML Infrastructure Architecture Pipeline",
        ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT,
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground=BG)])

ax.text(6.0, 2.05,
        "End-to-end data flow: Data Ingestion → Feature Engineering → Training → Serving → Experimentation → Monitoring",
        ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8.5, color='#90A4AE',
        path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground=BG)])

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

plt.tight_layout(pad=0.5)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none')
